name: American Wire Group
old_description: AWG specializes in providing wire and cable solutions for use in wind, solar, battery energy storage and EV infrastructure applications.
about:
Based in Aventura, Florida, with operation centers in Perris, California; Mechanicsburg, Pennsylvania; and Katy, Texas, American Wire Group (AWG) marks 25 years as a supplier and manufacturer of wire, cable, hardware, and accessories for utility and renewable energy markets. The company describes itself as a partner for industries that power the grid, though it does not disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or founders.

AWG maintains what it calls the largest inventory of wire and cable products in the United States, stocked across its coast-to-coast warehouses to enable delivery in days rather than weeks. Its capabilities span custom cable engineering and design, cable management and logistics, supply chain optimization, and a suite of value-added services such as cut-to-length, custom labeling, paralleling, connector installation, and reel recycling. The company also operates a 24/7 emergency response team that deploys materials for disaster recovery and grid restoration.

The company serves utilities, government agencies, and private-sector businesses in power transmission and distribution, substations, wind and solar farms, battery energy storage systems, data centers, and electric-vehicle charging infrastructure. Customers include utility companies and emergency response teams that rely on AWG for hard-to-find items and rapid material support during crises.

AWG emphasizes its ISO 9001:2015 certified quality management system, its nationwide inventory footprint, and its ability to provide engineered solutions from concept through installation as key differentiators. The firm states that its emergency response capabilities and comprehensive service model set it apart from competitors that only supply products.
